description: The bar chart illustrates performance gain (in percent) for three LVLM models under a condition labeled “Strong Supervision,” with two bars shown per model to represent two series distinguished by styling. The horizontal axis contains the model categories “GPT-4o,” “Claude-3.5-Sonnet,” and “Qwen2-72B-VL,” arranged left to right, while the vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gain (+%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 30 with tick marks at regular 5-unit intervals. For each model, a taller blue bar with diagonal hatch marks represents the “Strong Supervision” series: GPT-4o is approximately 24–25%, Claude-3.5-Sonnet is approximately 9–10%, and Qwen2-72B-VL is approximately 15%. A second, shorter solid light-blue bar appears alongside each hatched bar (no explicit legend text visible for this series): GPT-4o is about 5%, Claude-3.5-Sonnet about 3–4%, and Qwen2-72B-VL about 5%. The bars are grouped by model category (two adjacent bars per group), there is no stacking, and no explicit sorting beyond the left-to-right listing of the three model names; no individual bars are annotated with numeric labels or otherwise specially emphasized beyond the hatch pattern used for the “Strong Supervision” series.
